caption:
Every parent who worries should hear Yaqub's words

Yaqub asked his sons whether he should trust them with his son as he had once trusted them with his brother. Then he said that Allah is the best Protector and the Most Merciful of those who show mercy. A worried heart can rest in that.

Surah Yusuf 12:64

Send this to a parent who worries about their children.

#parenting #prophetyaqub #surahyusuf #allahprotects

Recitation: Abdul Basit Abdus-Samad
